resources.string: When active, pressing volume up or volume down sends an event to your configured server. A persistent notification is shown while the service runs.
Find “PulseFit Tracker” in the list and toggle it on/off.
URL must start with http:// or https://
Lets PulseFit Tracker detect volume up / volume down button presses and relay them to the server URL you configure in the app. Key presses are observed only; they are not blocked or modified.
Shown while the volume-button relay service is active
Relaying volume-button events to your server
